capabilities: Build a product catalog as notes with calories, protein, fat and carbs properties per 100 grams
Log daily food intake in a foodiary code block with product names and gram amounts
Compute per-product and total nutrition tables from catalog entries
Track consumed calories against a daily calorie goal set in note frontmatter
Optionally show fiber, cholesterol and sodium columns
extras: Documentation links to a sample vault; notes that the calorie goal is only detected after closing and reopening the note.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log daily food intake and compute its nutritional totals from your own product catalog.
summary: Food tracker that calculates calories and macronutrients from food entries listed in a code block in daily notes.
